senses.gloss: --one of the four tongues of the Veda. वा. १०४. ७४. [page३-327+ ३०]
(I)--a वैष्णव of the ardent type. Br. IV. 8. 44
(II)--practices for a ब्रह्मचारिन् before becoming a full fledged mendicant. Vi. III. १०. १५; IV. 2. १३०.

--a class of seers, born on व्यपोहिनि rite on ashes. पृथु became a वैखानस in the evening of his life; a son of नहुष;
2: M. २४. ५१.
Agastya followed the system;
3: Ib. ६१. ३७.
tapas in the forests.
4: Ib. १४५. २४; वा. 2. २७; ५९. २४.
